note: `starttab_initialized_rows` is the source-level semantic view of how many `_starttab` elements are defined at the event, measured by the Stage 04 helper `gt_assert_init_rows(_starttab, _numrows)` placed next to the vulnerable-original `_starttab` preparation and sink. `rows_checked_total` is the sink loop bound `_numrows`, i.e. the total number of `_starttab[o]` rows the sanity check will evaluate.
